reason: at 008e5eb3 an unapproved chore no longer blocks untagged evidence (hand run: chore-only subject, evidence add exits 0); no test exercises this fallback
summary: [standards] An unapproved chore blocks evidence through the untagged fallback. untagged_scope returns changes.last() with no kind filter when no adopted change has an Approved line, so a building subject adopting only an unapproved chore k (or feature f then chore k, none approved) refuses `evidence add` for an untagged scenario with BRIEF_UNAPPROVED naming k's brief (reproduced with the 344527ef binary). Brief F3: an unapproved chore blocks only reopen and ship, never evidence; the fallback waits for the newest adopted FEATURE change. The brief.rs module doc and README say the same. evidence.add.125 misses it because its Given has an approved change. Fix: skip chores in the fallback, and add a scenario/test for the chore-only and feature+chore setups.
